text: The pilot maneuvered the plane against a bone-gray dock
Paul, Stokharin and I scrambled onto the dock
Iris laughed and ran forward to greet us
she came first to me
she escorted us off the dock
across a narrow white beach to a grove of palm trees where the cottage stood.
Paul prowled restlessly about the modern living room
I must get back to New York soon, to the school.
so I came
I shouldn't really have gone off
no cranks have got through from the mainland
we're marooned here
Iris and I swam in the Gulf
the others never ventured out
we crawled up on the beach
a motorboat pulling into the dock.
We'd better go back to the house
groceries and mail to the house
Iris was already at the house
I limped toward the house
from a side door, the occupants of the house had begun to appear
fled into the house
other guards came
